description:
Progress delivered through the normal typed item/event path.

The thread and turn are part of the notification because user-visible activity has to be attributable: an execution id alone cannot say which conversation a line belongs in, and treating it as routing authority would let one thread's progress be drawn into another.

iconID.description: Which capability this line is about, as the tool registry names its icon. A surface that draws activity has only the execution id otherwise, so every capability ends up behind one generic glyph.

title: WhisplyToolProgress
